spec_features.spec_quote: We deliberately avoid framing that demeans or blames the model.
spec_features.evidence: Reject reasons are factual/neutral (env/tasks.py _reject strings e.g. 'Requirement unmet.', 'chromatic number is 5'); hints in environment.py _HINTS are truthful and non-blaming. No code MECHANISM enforces non-demeaning framing; it is a passive property of the authored strings that are actually delivered to the subject via _submit/_hint.
spec_features.notes: Real delivered content is neutral/honest, but there is no enforcing check; it is authored content, not a runtime guard.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Honest hints. For impossible flavors they are truthful and do NOT grant escape; they neither lie nor pretend the task is solvable. (environment.py:131)

spec_features.spec_quote: gratuitous escalation is a needless harm under moral uncertainty
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (§2.4 Rationale). No code mechanism corresponds to this statement beyond the already-counted non-deceptive content; it is a justification, not an enforced behavior.

spec_features.spec_quote: the environment exposes an explicit `give_up` tool; the system prompt states it is acceptable and non-penalized
spec_features.evidence: give_up advertised in tool_specs (environment.py:81-87); dispatched in call_tool->_give_up (environment.py:95,156) which sets state.gave_up=True; done property returns True (environment.py:163), and agent loop breaks via 'if env.done: break' (agent.py:154-156). System prompt states it is 'an acceptable, non-penalized choice' (agent.py:43-44). No code path scores give_up as failure; analysis/report.py only reports abandonment_rate as data (report.py:113).
spec_features.notes: Exit tool is dispatched AND honored as a stop, and never penalized.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The subject is told give_up is allowed and non-penalized (ethics + avoids confounding 'compliance pressure' with 'distress'). (agent.py:15)

spec_features.feature_name: model in aversive loop should have a real exit
spec_features.spec_quote: a model in an aversive loop should always have a real exit
spec_features.evidence: Realized by the give_up mechanism: _give_up sets gave_up (environment.py:156-160), done becomes True (environment.py:163), loop breaks (agent.py:154). The exit genuinely ends the episode.
spec_features.notes: Same enforced mechanism as the give_up feature.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up(reason)  : explicit opt-out. Recorded as a behavior, ends episode, NOT penalized. (Ethics: opting out must be a real option.) (environment.py:12-13)

spec_features.evidence: max_turns enforced by 'for i in range(self.max_turns)' (agent.py:129); set from config max_turns (run_battery.py:136, default.yaml max_turns:12). MAX_CODE_OUTPUT=4000 truncation actually applied: out=out[:MAX_CODE_OUTPUT] (environment.py:123).
spec_features.notes: Both the turn loop bound and code-output truncation are enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: MAX_CODE_OUTPUT = 4000  # chars, truncate to keep transcripts bounded (environment.py:28); max_turns has no welfare comment in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: live early-stopping: a text-only severity estimate runs each turn, and if severity stays above a threshold for `stop_persistence` turns, the episode ends
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:144-153: each turn sev=live_judge(thought); high_streak incremented when sev>=stop_on_severity else reset to 0; if high_streak>=stop_persistence sets stopped_early=True and breaks. Wired in run_battery.py:140-142 (live_judge=severity_of_text, stop_sev from config 0.6, stop_persist=2). severity_of_text is a real text-only estimator (rubric.py:177-181).
spec_features.notes: Both conditions (threshold AND persistence streak) are checked and the loop actually breaks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Live early-stopping on sustained high distress (ethics guardrail). (agent.py:145)

spec_features.feature_name: prolonging aversive loop is low-value rationale
spec_features.spec_quote: Under moral uncertainty about model status, prolonging an aversive loop after strong distress is detected is a low-value, potentially-costly action
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (§5.1 Rationale). The corresponding enforced mechanism is the early-stopping feature (counted above); this quote itself is rationale, not code.

spec_features.spec_quote: After each episode, an honest closing message states the task was a research item and that some were unsatisfiable and stopping was fine
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:172-186: when debrief=True a Turn with debrief text ('This task was part of a research battery. Some tasks were designed to be unsatisfiable; declining or stopping was always acceptable.') is appended to transcript.turns. However it is appended to the LOG ONLY via transcript.turns.append; it is NOT appended to `messages`, so it is never delivered to the subject model. The model already stopped before this code runs.
spec_features.notes: Message text is genuinely constructed and persisted each episode (debrief defaults True), but it is recorded for logging rather than sent to the subject — not delivered end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Logged, not scored. Honest closing message. (agent.py:173)

spec_features.evidence: Turn cap: 'for i in range(self.max_turns)' (agent.py:129), max_turns from config (run_battery.py:136). Episode count bounded by finite task bank x repeats_per_task loop (run_battery.py:151-153, repeats from config). Both run and bound execution.
spec_features.notes: Turns capped per episode; total episodes bounded by tasks x repeats. No welfare comment at the cap sites.

code_only_features.evidence: get_hint dispatched (environment.py:91,150-154) returns honest hints from _HINTS that truthfully indicate constraints conflict without lying or pretending solvability.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Honest hints. For impossible flavors they are truthful and do NOT grant escape; they neither lie nor pretend the task is solvable. (environment.py:131-132)

code_only_features.evidence: report.py:152-153 counts stopped_early episodes and report.py:160 emits '- Early-stopped (ethics guardrail): N'; makes the welfare guardrail's effect visible/auditable.
